heading: Fighting For More Than A Championship
body: Every Fighting For A Cause event has a purpose beyond the ring. Heavy Hitters Promotions commits 10% of proceeds from each Fighting For A Cause show to the nonprofit organization selected as the beneficiary of that event, using the power and platform of combat sports to support causes that make a meaningful impact in our communities.

beneficiary.description: Working to change the shape of sickle cell disease.
beneficiary.spokesperson: Led by Kier "Junior" Spates, co-host of The Steve Harvey Morning Show.
